Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer orders throughout the entire order-to-cash process.
• Enter and follow up on orders in the ERP system.
• Serve as the primary contact for customer enquiries regarding orders, deliveries, and product availability.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.
• Resolve customer issues and identify appropriate solutions.
• Maintain accurate customer records and administrative documentation.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.
• Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Sales Support, or a similar administrative position.
• Strong communication skills and customer-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English. French is considered an asset.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP knowledge is a plus).
• Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

jobs.occupation: Atcon Global - Junior Data & AI Consultant
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Junior Data & AI Consultant to join our growing technology team in Belgium. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to develop their career at the intersection of Data, Analytics, Cloud and Artificial Intelligence.

You will work closely with clients, business stakeholders, data engineers and technical teams to transform business needs into data-driven and AI-powered solutions.
Responsibilities

• Understand business requirements and translate them into data and AI solutions

• Support the design and implementation of data pipelines, analytics and AI use cases

• Work with structured and unstructured data and contribute to data preparation and analysis

• Develop dashboards, reports and data visualizations

• Support the development and integration of AI / Machine Learning solutions

• Work with technologies such as Python, SQL, Power BI and cloud platforms

• Assist with data quality, data governance and documentation activities

• Collaborate with clients and technical teams in an Agile environment

• Stay up to date with emerging Generative AI, Machine Learning and Data technologies

• Minimum 1-4 years of experience in Data, Business Intelligence, Analytics, AI or a related field

• Good knowledge of SQL and Python

• Experience with at least one BI / visualization tool, preferably Power BI

• Basic understanding of Data Engineering, APIs, databases and cloud technologies

• Exposure to Machine Learning, AI or Generative AI is a strong plus

Nice to have:

• Experience with Azure, AWS or GCP

• Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or Azure Data Factory

• Familiarity with Machine Learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow or PyTorch

• Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, RAG or AI agents

• Knowledge of data governance or data management concepts

• Consulting or client-facing experience

Behavioural and other requirements

• Good analytical and problem-solving skills

• Comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders

• Willingness to learn new technologies and work in a consulting environment

• Fluent in French or Dutch, with good English communication skills

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Business Analytics or a related field

Driven by entrepreneurship, excellence, and collaboration, they empower their consultants to build strong market expertise, develop meaningful business relationships, and make a lasting impact on companies and professionals alike.

• Support professionals in making important career decisions.

Drive successful recruitment projects

• Manage recruitment assignments from A to Z.
• Match talent with business needs.
• Negotiate offers and facilitate successful placements.
• Build long-term relationships with both clients and candidates.

 

You don't necessarily need recruitment experience to succeed.

• Speak English with at least a native level in French OR Dutch.
• Are passionate about building relationships.
• Have a strong commercial mindset.
• Enjoy working towards ambitious goals.
• Are naturally curious and eager to learn about businesses and industries.
• Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Experience in sales, consulting, business development, customer success, hospitality, banking, or recruitment is considered a plus.

jobs.occupation: S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist - Drive digital transformation in a cloud environment
jobs.description:
Ready to use your SAP expertise in a project that makes a real impact? This is your opportunity to play a key role in a major digital transformation within an international organization that is investing heavily in innovation, technology, and process optimization.

For a leading company active in the housing and real estate sector, we are looking for a temporary reinforcement to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You will join a forward-thinking environment where your contribution will directly influence the success of an important digitalization project.
Your responsibilities
As an S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist, you will help ensure a smooth and successful implementation process by:

• Supporting the rollout of SAP S/4HANA Cloud across the organization
• Assisting in the optimization and digitalization of business processes
• Providing support to end users and answering system-related questions
• Executing test scenarios and documenting findings
• Analyzing workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners
• Creating and maintaining process documentation and user guidelines
• Contributing to a seamless transition toward the new ERP environment
In short, this is a varied position where you can make a tangible contribution to a high-impact transformation project.

We are seeking a proactive professional who can quickly adapt to a dynamic project environment and enjoys improving processes.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential
• Familiarity with cloud-based ERP systems
• Fluent communication skills in English
• Previous experience in ERP implementation, digital transformation, or system migration projects
• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues
• An understanding of business processes in sales, operations, or administration is a plus
You do not need to know everything already, but a solid SAP foundation and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in this role.

jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a hands-on job in a growing company within the plastics industry? Do you enjoy physical work and being part of a team? Then this opportunity could be perfect for you!

To support a major new project, we are looking for motivated and committed Production Workers to join the shipping department.

Your responsibilities will include:

 
• Assisting with the assembly of wooden crates used for packaging and shipping products.
 
• Working together with a colleague to stack and assemble the crate components using an ergonomic support system.
 
• Carefully packing finished automotive parts into the crates.
 
• Securing the products properly, closing the crates with lids and straps, and preparing them for shipment.
 
• Attaching the correct shipping labels to the finished crates.

 
• You are motivated, reliable, and eager to work.
 
• You are comfortable performing physically demanding tasks.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy working in a team environment.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English.
 
• You are flexible and willing to work in a 2-shift system.
 
• Experience in production or logistics is an asset but not required.

A strong financial profile with people management skills and a passion for process optimisation? As an AP Manager at Lotus Bakeries, you will have the opportunity to take on a key role within an international environment in Lembeke.

In this versatile role, you will combine people management with operational responsibility and process optimisation. You will have the freedom to take initiative, implement improvements and contribute to building efficient and future-proof Accounts Payable processes.

 

 

 

 

 

 

Your responsibilities:

As an AP Manager, you will be responsible for Accounts Payable services across multiple entities and countries.

• Lead, coach and develop the AP team (9 people), allocate workloads and ensure efficient operations and continuity.
• Coordinate the entire AP flow, from invoice receipt, processing and approval through to payments and supplier management, while ensuring process quality and timely execution.
• Monitor KPIs and SLAs, analyse workload and performance, and take action where necessary to further improve service delivery.
• Act as the first point of contact for complex AP matters and work closely with Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Treasury and external stakeholders.
• Ensure compliance with accounting policies, tax and legal requirements, as well as internal controls, and support internal and external audits.
• Analyse AP and cash management processes, including payment timing, DPO and cash discounts, and initiate concrete improvements.
• Identify opportunities for automation and process optimisation and contribute to finance transformation and system projects, such as SAP, VIM and Concur.
 

 

Your profile:

• You hold a Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or an equivalent field, combined with at least 5 years of relevant experience in AP or Accounting, preferably within an international or shared services environment.
• You have experience in people management and know how to coach, motivate and further develop a team.
• You have strong knowledge of AP accounting, VAT and invoice-to-pay processes, as well as experience with ERP systems; knowledge of SAP and VIM is a plus.
• You are analytical and KPI-driven, with strong knowledge of MS Excel and standard Office tools.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• You are organised, proactive and solution-oriented, with the ability to set priorities effectively in a dynamic FMCG environment.
• You are a strong communicator with a stakeholder-oriented mindset and identify with values such as team spirit, open dialogue and passion.

Take the next step in your accounting career within a growing healthcare environment. An exciting opportunity is available for a Senior Accountant seeking a varied role with regional exposure across the Benelux. This position offers the chance to combine accounting expertise, financial reporting, tax compliance, and process improvement while contributing to an organisation dedicated to improving quality of life through healthcare solutions.

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

• Manage the full accounting cycle for several Benelux entities.
• Process purchase invoices, bank transactions, payroll entries, and general ledger postings.
• Perform monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing activities.
• Prepare and execute supplier payments.
• Assist with VAT returns, Intrastat declarations, and tax-related filings.
• Support the preparation of annual accounts and audit documentation.
• Review and reconcile intercompany transactions and balances.
• Handle HR-related administrative tasks for selected entities.
• Contribute to financial projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Provide support on ad hoc accounting and reporting activities.

About You

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• You have at between 4 and 10 years of experience in accounting, financial reporting, or controlling.
• You possess solid knowledge of Belgian accounting regulations; knowledge of Luxembourg and Dutch accounting standards is an asset.
• You have experience with audits, tax compliance, and financial controls.
• You work confidently with Excel and the MS Office suite.
• You are familiar with ERP systems; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a strong advantage.
• You have a good understanding of VAT and corporate tax regulations within the Benelux region.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and French, with a good command of English.
• You demonstrate strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.
• You manage deadlines effectively and can prioritize multiple responsibilities.
• You work autonomously while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
• You take a proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges.
• You handle sensitive financial information with integrity and discretion.
• You explain financial data clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

jobs.occupation: Truck Mechanic Wanted – Build Your Career as a Commercial Vehicle Technician!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you are the technical expert who keeps our fleet of DAF trucks in top condition. You perform accurate diagnostics and repairs, carry out maintenance, and see electrical issues as challenges rather than problems. With your technical expertise, especially in electronics and vehicle technology, you are an indispensable part of the team.

An average workday starts with analyzing diagnostic reports. You read wiring diagrams, test wiring harnesses and control units, and carry out repairs according to the latest technical updates from the manufacturer. You communicate clearly with customers and the manufacturer about the work you perform. Additionally, you lead and support fellow mechanics and provide technical assistance to our branch in Herent as needed.

Are you ready to further develop your technical skills and take on a key role in a growing team? Apply now and give your career as a truck mechanic a powerful boost!

What we ask:

• Technical secondary education (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent through experience

• Professional bachelor's degree in Automotive Technology or equivalent is a plus

• Minimum 2 years of relevant experience as a truck or commercial vehicle mechanic

• Solid basic knowledge of electronics and experience in the automotive sector

• Ability to read electrical diagrams and analyze malfunctions

• Leadership skills and ability to coordinate a team

• Motivated, hands-on, and responsible

• C(E) driving license is an advantage but not required

• Good command of English (spoken)

• Available for day shift or 2-shift system

jobs.occupation: Production Operator - Immediate Start in a Growing Coatings Company
jobs.description:
Your Role

As a Production Operator Coatings, you are hands-on in the entire coatings production process. You ensure every batch is produced accurately and safely, from raw material to finished product.

What You Will Do

• Prepare raw materials and equipment

• Accurately weigh and add ingredients following recipes

• Operate and monitor mixing installations

• Closely follow mixing parameters (temperature, timing, method)

• Take samples and assist with quality controls

• Register production and quality data accurately

• Fill finished coatings into packaging and check weights

• Label and palletize finished products

• Keep machines and workstations clean and safe

• Report issues or deviations promptly

• Support your colleagues and be flexible within production

A Typical Day

You start the day by preparing materials and checking your workstation. Throughout the day, you follow set procedures for mixing and quality control, keep accurate records, and communicate any issues to your team leader. You end your shift with a tidy workplace and clear handover for the next day.

Ready to grow with us?

If you are looking for a varied, responsible role in production and want to be part of an ambitious team, we encourage you to apply!

• Minimum a few years of experience in a production environment (mixing, weighing, quality control)

• Experience with paint, coatings, chemical products, or mixing is a strong advantage

• Physically able to regularly lift weights up to 25kg

• B driving license required; willing to occasionally drive to Brussels

• Forklift experience for handling heavy pallets

• Very good command of English; understanding of Dutch is an asset

• Flexible, all-round team player

• Motivated for a long-term collaboration
